description: Create an inventory item. PROTOCOL (designed for spoken dialogue): 1) call get_item_requirements and resolve the category with your user — offer the 2–4 most likely existing categories, never the whole list, and a category is REQUIRED (only a draft may go without one) and you must sanity-check that the chosen one actually FITS the item: if it doesn't, or no fitting category exists, say so BEFORE your confirmation summary and offer the honest paths — create it under the closest category while saying so, save it with isDraft: true for the user to finish in the app, or — only when the user explicitly asks for it — create the fitting category yourself with create_category (prefer existing categories otherwise); a create without categoryId returns { missingCategory, categories } and writes nothing; 2) call get_item_requirements with the categoryId to learn the still-missing required fields — in widget-rendering hosts (e.g. ChatGPT) do NOT ask for them in conversation: call preview_item_create with what you have and the card collects them; elsewhere collect them in ONE compact question ("I need three things: …"), not one question per field; 3) fill what you can from context yourself — a photo, the conversation, sensible defaults — conservatively, and MARK every assumed value when you summarize ("I assumed condition 'good' — say so if not"); 4) state a one-sentence summary including your assumptions and get your user's OK BEFORE calling this tool; 5) create with a fresh clientRequestId (e.g. a UUID) — retrying with the SAME id returns the existing item instead of a duplicate. If required fields are missing the call returns { missingFields } instead of creating — ask your user and retry with the values in customFields (keys = fieldDefId from get_item_requirements). If your user can't provide everything now, retry with isDraft: true: the item is saved as an incomplete draft they can finish later in the app — offer this instead of stalling. Item creation requires the manager role. For quantity-tracked stock (consumables like paper or markers) pass trackingMode "quantity" with quantity (and optional minStock). In hosts that render widgets (e.g. ChatGPT), prefer calling preview_item_create for step 4 instead of a prose summary — it renders an editable confirm card that calls this tool directly.

categoryId.description: Category id (resolve with get_item_requirements) — required unless isDraft is true

clientRequestId.description: Recommended: a unique id you generate for this creation (e.g. a UUID). Retrying with the SAME id returns the existing item instead of creating a duplicate. Use a fresh id for each new item.

customFields.description: Field values keyed by fieldDefId (from get_item_requirements). Dates as a plain calendar day "YYYY-MM-DD" (a full timestamp works too, but only WITH an explicit offset — this server has no timezone and does no conversion), selects as one of the listed options, multiselect as an ARRAY of option strings, currency as a plain number in the field's own currency (see its currencyCode; default CHF), url as a full http(s) link (protocol added when missing).

homeLocationId.description: Home location resource id (find with search_resources); omit to use the org/category default

isDraft.description: Save as an incomplete draft (skips the required-fields check; the user finishes it in the app)

minStock.description: Optional restock threshold for quantity-tracked stock

quantity.description: Initial stock amount — required with trackingMode "quantity"

trackingMode.description: Pass "quantity" for quantity-tracked stock (consumables) instead of a serialized single item

name: create_item

allowance.description: Items the organization's package includes, with itemLimitReached

categories.description: The organization's category tree, sent with a missingCategory round so the retry costs one call. Empty means the org has no categories yet

compartment.description: The compartment of that container the item sits in (absent = directly in the container)

container.description: The container this item is packed into, if any

effectiveHolder.description: Holder followed through the container chain

effectiveLocation.description: Location followed through the container chain

instruction.description: What to do next — present on every round that wrote nothing (missing fields, missing category, allowance reached)

isDraft.description: Present and true only for an unfinished draft capture

itemLimitReached.description: Present and true when the organization is at its included item allowance — nothing was created and no retry of this call will succeed

missingCategory.description: Present and true when the call carried no categoryId — nothing was created; every item except a draft needs a category

missingFieldLabels.description: Labels a saved DRAFT still needs before it can be published — the user finishes them in the app

missingFields.description: Present INSTEAD of the item when required values are missing — nothing was created; ask your user and retry with them in customFields

currencyCode.description: ISO code of a currency field when it is not CHF (absent = CHF)

label.description: Field label as the org named it

type.description: Field type: text | number | date | select | multiselect | …

modelId.description: The item's model — pass it as create_order lines[].modelId to order any instance of this model

primaryCode.description: The code printed on the item's asset tag — how a human tells two identical models apart. Absent when no code is attached

quantity.description: How many this row stands for — only on quantity-tracked pools. To count a pool, SUM this; to count serialized items, count rows

status.description: Condition: available | in_repair | defect | lost | retired ("available" means not defect/lost/retired — the item may still be borrowed)

trackingMode.description: "quantity" for a stock pool counted by amount. Absent = a serialized item, i.e. this row IS one physical thing

usage.description: Tracked items the organization has, with itemLimitReached

webUrl.description: Link to this item in the web app — give it to your user so they can look at the record themselves. Absent when the deployment has no public address configured

title: Create item
